name: 7Hz
description: 7Hz earned their legendary status in the audiophile community by breaking the "planar barrier." While early planar magnetic IEMs were bulky and difficult to tune, 7Hz successfully engineered a massive 14.5mm planar driver into a comfortable form factor. They are famous for intense, holographic 3D soundstages, blisteringly fast transient speeds, and highly competitive, ultra-budget-friendly sub-brands.

name: DUNU
description: Formed originally as an OEM/ODM manufacturer in 2002, DUNU has decades of specialized acoustic experience. They are globally revered by audiophiles for having the best build quality in the Chi-Fi landscape. DUNU is famous for its advanced material science (like carbon and beryllium coatings) and its patented, universally praised modular quick-switch audio cables.

name: FiiO
description: FiiO is the undisputed infrastructure and ecosystem titan of Chinese portable audio. Originally legendary for creating portable amplifiers and high-resolution Digital Audio Players (DAPs), FiiO successfully funneled its massive engineering budget into a sprawling line of IEMs. They are famous for exceptional mechanical builds, structural modularity, and high driver counts at fair price-to-performance metrics.

name: Kinera Audio
description: Founded in 2016, Kinera treats IEM design like fine art. They are globally famous for their gorgeous, hand-painted custom resin outer shells and themes heavily rooted in Norse mythology. Kinera is a master of "triple-hybrid" and "quad-hybrid" platforms, packing dynamic drivers, balanced armatures, planar micro-drivers, and electrostatic units into single ear structures. They also run highly successful sister brands like Celest and QoA (Queen of Audio) to cover the budget markets.

name: Kiwi Ears
description: Kiwi Ears operates like an exclusive boutique skunkworks laboratory. Led by a highly revered, anonymous master acoustic engineer, the company focuses heavily on catering to musicians, studio engineers, and critical casual listeners. They are highly famous for hand-crafted, beautiful medical-grade resin shells and complex "multi-brid" setups that mash dynamic, armature, planar, and piezoelectric technologies together.

name: KZ
description: Founded in 2012, KZ (Knowledge Zenith) is the historic gateway grandfather of the Chi-Fi movement. They single-handedly disrupted the global audio market by introducing multi-driver hybrid setups for under $30. KZ operates as a high-volume manufacturing powerhouse, rapidly turning out aggressive, energetic V-shaped audio signatures. They are incredibly popular among budget-conscious musicians, casual listeners, and competitive gamers.

name: Moondrop
description: Founded in 2015, Moondrop is arguably the most famous and culturally dominant Chi-Fi brand in the world. They popularized target-curve tuning metrics (using their signature VDSF target curve) to achieve highly natural, vocal-forward sound signatures. They are equally famous for their intricate structural engineering and their unmistakable anime-inspired aesthetic packaging.
